I tried scalping on an HFM KATANA account.
I've only ever done domestic FX and it was my first time trading on MT5.
My impressions: execution is good. Closing all positions at once is also good. The panel can't do opposite trades; you close positions inside the toolbox. You have to move the mouse back and forth between the toolbox and the panel when closing or adding to a position, which takes getting used to, but operation is fine.
The USDJPY spread is 0.4-0.6, which is narrow enough.
I tried scalping and won every trade. I'm confident the trading method I teach works well enough for scalping. The broker is also quite good compared with other overseas brokers. There's no downside to opening an account.
